documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Submission Of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026

analysis.summary: J.G. Chemicals Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, achieving its best-ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management highlighted double-digit volume growth, a zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeding 80%, and ongoing expansion projects in Dahej and Naidupeta to capture future demand from automotive and tyre sectors. The company continues to diversify its product portfolio into non-rubber applications such as ceramics, agriculture, and pharmaceuticals to improve margins. Furthermore, management emphasized structural immunity from Chinese competition and a natural LME-linked pricing hedge.

guidance.claim: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27.
guidance.quote: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27, positioning the Company to meet anticipated demand growth from the tyre sector and other end-user industries.

guidance.claim: Management expects further margin improvement as new capacities ramp up and value-added products contribute a greater share of revenue.
guidance.quote: Sustained profitability across both quarters supports management’s expectation of further margin improvement as new capacities ramp up and value-added products contribute a greater share of revenue.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to reach approximately 14% to 15% with a higher share of value-added products.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

demand_outlook.claim: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately Rs 25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately ₹25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production.

demand_outlook.claim: Shorter customer approval cycles in ceramics enable faster market penetration, broadening the customer base.
demand_outlook.quote: Shorter customer approval cycles in ceramics—typically 1–3 months—enable faster market penetration, broadening JGC’s customer base and reducing dependence on individual end-user industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27, continuing into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as demand is concerned, our customers, the tire and the rubber, remain the largest pillar of our business, and demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, and this has continued into the current quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that volume growth was in double digits for the current quarter across categories.
demand_outlook.quote: And the volume growth was in double digits for the current quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: The company witnessed strong demand and volume growth across all end user applications in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand and volume growth was witnessed across all end user applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1 FY27 recorded volume growth across major vehicle categories as reported by ATMA.
demand_outlook.quote: As Per ATMA, Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories — PV +26.6% YoY, 2W +16.58% YoY, CV +16.48% YoY, 3W +11.32% YoY.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong demand from OEMs coupled with replacement demand will aid future growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from the OEM’s coupled with strong replacement demand will aid future growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project is nearing completion, with trial runs scheduled for next month.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project, comprising approximately 15,000 MTPA of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000+ MTPA facility, is nearing completion, with trial runs scheduled for next month.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in 2026 to support future capacity expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Our material subsidiary i.e. BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd has acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, in 2026, to support future capacity expansion and long-term growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield chemical facility involves an investment of about INR100 crores with an estimated revenue potential of INR900 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

margins_costs.claim: JGC recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71% in Q2 FY27, improving 79 bps YoY from 9.92%, despite higher energy prices and freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: JGC recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71% in Q2 FY27, improving 79 bps YoY from 9.92%, despite higher energy prices and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: The company's pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements, helping mitigate raw material price risk.
margins_costs.quote: The Company’s pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements, helping mitigate raw material price risk.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74%, improving 92 bps YoY from 6.82%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74 %, improving 92 bps YoY from 6.82%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company is neutral to zinc prices.
margins_costs.quote: We are neutral to zinc prices, if you ask me honestly. So, whether zinc is at 3,000 or 3,500 or 3,600, it really doesn't matter to us.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeded 80% with further improvement expected.
orders_capacity.quote: zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeding 80% and further improvement expected.

orders_capacity.claim: The total capacity additions at Dahej and Naidupeta will increase total zinc oxide capacity to 79,904 MTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Together, these additions will increase total zinc oxide capacity to 79,904 MTPA, providing capacity to support anticipated demand through FY28 and FY29.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity across manufacturing facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Current utilization levels are in the early 80s.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the utilization levels are in early 80s right now as we speak.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted continued volatility in global supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite continued volatility in global supply chains, JGC’s goodwill, long-standing supplier relationships, scale and financial strength ensured uninterrupted zinc raw material supply, supporting sales growth and reinforcing customer confidence.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that ongoing geopolitical conflict caused severe global supply chain disruptions for zinc dross over the last quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: As far as raw material security is concerned, despite the ongoing global supply chain disruption, which has been quite severe over the last quarter because of the war, etcetera.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted global supply chain disruptions during recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite global supply chain disruption, JGC's scale, financial strength and long term supplier relationships have ensured uninterrupted supply of raw material during the last few months.

management_commitments.claim: Pharmaceutical Grade Zinc Oxide operations are planned to commence in 12–15 months.
New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27, positioning the Company to meet anticipated demand growth from the tyre sector and other end-user industries.

management_commitments.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management estimates the Dahej plant will come up in November.
management_commitments.quote: I would say, it will be sometime in November would be a good estimate.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commission the Dahej greenfield facility in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to commission the Naidupeta brownfield expansion in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to continue the strong performance momentum going forward.
management_commitments.quote: The current quarter is also witnessing strong performance and we expect to continue the strong momentum going forward

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase the contribution of non-rubber revenues from 15% to 30% over the next few years.
management_commitments.quote: increasing the contribution of non-rubber revenues from the current 15% to 30% over the next few years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
